So, what are you waiting for? Dive into this wacky world and experience the thrill of 'Toilet Rush Draw To Pee' for yourself!

sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
In 'Toilet Rush Draw To Pee', you'll encounter three distinct game modes: Drawing Mode, Rope Mode, and Toilet Rooms. Drawing Mode is the most straightforward of the three, where you'll guide each character to the toilet by drawing a line from the character to the toilet. Sounds simple, right? Well, things get complicated quickly, as you'll need to avoid collisions with various objects, including other characters, that will burst your character if they collide.

One of the most challenging aspects of Drawing Mode is navigating the various obstacles that will pop up to block your path. From spinning blades to spiky surfaces, these obstacles will require quick reflexes and sharp drawing skills to overcome. But don't worry, with practice, you'll soon become a master of the drawing game, and your skills will improve with each passing level.

But Drawing Mode isn't the only game mode in 'Toilet Rush Draw To Pee'. Rope Mode requires you to grab a rope from one edge of the screen and transfer it to the other, all while avoiding thorns and other obstacles that will burst your character. This mode adds a fresh twist to the game, requiring you to think strategically and move quickly to succeed.

Finally, Toilet Rooms mode allows you to earn coins, open objects in rooms, and decorate them to unlock unique music for each room. This mode adds a new level of depth to the game, allowing you to collect rewards and customize your experience like never before.
